name: Production PostgreSQL Validation & Persistence Verification
notes: PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL was not set in environment or .env. Per strict instructions, no synthetic credentials were created.
SQLAlchemy 2.0 schema and models (Match, Delivery, MatchState) were verified to compile into valid PostgreSQL DDL with proper SERIAL types and unique constraints.
psycopg v3 driver (3.3.6) is installed and verified; psycopg2-binary is completely excluded.
DATABASE_URL normalization logic in backend/database.py handles postgres:// and postgresql:// transparently, upgrading them to postgresql+psycopg://.
Real completed T20 match ('Luxembourg Women vs Belgium Women, 4th T20I') was ingested from Cricket Data API via match_sync.py and persisted.
Persistence verified across database sessions and separate subprocess restart.
Deduplication verified: repeated execution of match_sync skipped the match with 0 duplicate rows created.
Zero-API-call browsing verified: network calls were monkeypatched to throw exceptions, and GET /api/recent/matches and GET /api/recent/matches/<id> succeeded with 0 external requests.
Analysis available flag behavior verified: provider match without ball-by-ball stream safely stored real metadata with analysis_available=false and zero fabricated deliveries.
Historical replay and terminal state handling verified (100% win on target reached, 0% on all-out/balls exhausted).
Model integrity verified: models/logistic_regression_win_probability.joblib pipeline with StandardScaler + LogisticRegression and exact 8 features in exact order remains frozen.
Security verified: .env is ignored by Git, no credentials tracked in version control, and frontend contains zero secrets.
